Answers to your four points:
  > 1. **"Ours".** No single method was pre-declared. Use `uniform|diff-irt` only as "design-agnostic difference estimator" (ratio to uniform at n = 100: 0.70 interp, 0.73 lineage, 0.85 extrap). For the headline row use the two best by the primary endpoint and label them post-hoc: `balanced|diff-irt` (0.65 / 0.70 / 0.82) and `pps|diff-irt` (0.65 / 0.70 / 0.85); also show `balanced|calreg` (0.71 / 0.74 / 0.77), which is best in extrapolation and needs no model. Show `strat|mean` as a second baseline row (column `baseline` in `primary.csv`).
  > 2. **Fig. 5.** Your formula is right for my quantities (q = 1 − Brier_model / mean μ(1−μ) on unsampled items, residual SD ratio sqrt(1−q)), with one correction to how it is read: it fits in extrapolation (observed 0.854 vs predicted 0.847, geomean over 13) but observed is clearly *below* the prediction in interp/lineage (0.70 vs 0.81; gpqa 0.54 vs 0.89), so draw it as a reference curve, not as a ceiling, and label it "SRS-residual prediction". Use the `uniform|diff-irt` row; q_irt column.
  > 3. **Intervals for Fig. 3 / Fig. 6.** Not yet. I will add family-bootstrap bands for `bias_by_score` and `pairwise` (pooled over non-thin benchmarks, same replicates scheme) in the next analysis pass; until then draw no band, as you planned.
  > 4. **n/N = 2 %.** Being computed (n = round(0.02 N) per benchmark; own runs, not interpolated). File `results/twopct/primary.csv` (n label 0, column `n_actual`) when finished; the schema is otherwise the same as `primary.csv`. I will comment here when it lands.
  > Also coming: `results/msrc.csv` (error vs number of source models M, n = 100: columns split, M, method, geomean_ratio, ci_lo, ci_hi, n_bench; M = 0 means all sources).
